text: @dragon-talon/dsh-openspec 是面向 DeepSeek Harness 的工作流技能插件，将 OpenSpec 的 12 个规范技能注册到 DSH 技能服务，供模型与用户调用，并默认提供 12 个仅供用户触发的 /opsx-* 别名。技能覆盖探索想法、新建和推进变更、编写与同步规格、实现任务、验证及归档，也支持关闭别名。它适合在 DSH 中按 OpenSpec 流程规划和交付代码变更的开发者；需要由宿主提供 Cordis、技能与不变量服务。

@dragon-talon/dsh-openspec adds 12 OpenSpec workflow skills and 12 optional user-only /opsx-* aliases to DSH. Skills guide exploration, change planning, implementation, verification, and archiving. It is for developers following OpenSpec in DSH; host services provide Cordis, skills, and invariants.
我想让 DSH 按 OpenSpec 工作流带着我从想法走到代码变更。
有没有办法在 DSH 里分步骤创建变更提案和规格文档？
希望模型能根据 OpenSpec 任务清单继续实现功能。
怎么让 DSH 一次生成一个变更所需的全部规划工件？
我想把变更里的增量规格同步回主规格。
需要在 DSH 里验证实现是否符合变更工件并归档已完成的变更。
I want DSH to guide me through an OpenSpec change from exploration to implementation.
Can I create and advance specification artifacts through skills in DSH?
Help me implement tasks from a planned change and verify the result.
I need to sync delta specs and archive completed changes from my DSH workflow.
**@dragon-talon/dsh-openspec** 的功能「探索想法」：通过规范技能进入探索模式，协助梳理想法、调查问题并澄清需求。用户可调用 openspec-explore 技能启动这类讨论。
**@dragon-talon/dsh-openspec** 的功能「规划变更」：提供新建、继续、更新和快速完成 OpenSpec 变更工件的技能，分别用于创建提案、逐步生成下一份工件、修订现有规划或一次性生成全部工件。
**@dragon-talon/dsh-openspec** 的功能「实现与验证」：提供从变更任务清单着手实现、检查实现与变更工件是否一致的工作流技能，并可将已完成变更归档。用户或模型可调用对应的规范技能。
**@dragon-talon/dsh-openspec** 的功能「/opsx 命令别名」：默认注册 12 个仅用户可调用的别名，沿用对应规范技能正文；设 aliases=false 可关闭别名，规范技能仍会注册。
**@dragon-talon/dsh-openspec** 使用前需要 DSH 宿主提供 Cordis、技能注册和不变量服务；插件本身通过技能注册表登记内容。

@dragon-talon/dsh-openspec README · @dragon-talon/dsh-openspec：A [Cordis](https://github.com/cordiverse/cordis) plugin for DeepSeek Harness that registers the 12 canonical [OpenSpec](https://github.com/Fission-AI/OpenSpec) workflow skills under their kebab-case names — so `/openspec-new-change` works natively through DSH's user-invocation injection and the `skill` tool — plus the Claude-style `/opsx-<id>` command aliases as user-only skills that resolve to the canonical body.

@dragon-talon/dsh-openspec README · OpenSpec version：This package pins the OpenSpec workflow skills to **OpenSpec 1.14.1** ([`@fission-ai/openspec`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@fission-ai/openspec), source: [`Fission-AI/OpenSpec`](https://github.com/Fission-AI/OpenSpec)).

The skill bodies are generated by [`scripts/sync-openspec-skills.mjs`](scripts/sync-openspec-skills.mjs) from the OpenSpec repository's `skills/*/SKILL.md` files. See [Syncing skills](#syncing-skills).

@dragon-talon/dsh-openspec README · Skills：| Canonical skill | `/opsx-*` alias | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `openspec-explore` | `/opsx-explore` | Enter explore mode — a thinking partner for exploring ideas, investigating problems, and clarifying requirements. |
| `openspec-new-change` | `/opsx-new` | Start a new OpenSpec change using the experimental artifact workflow. |
| `openspec-continue-change` | `/opsx-continue` | Continue working on an OpenSpec change by creating the next artifact. |
| `openspec-apply-change` | `/opsx-apply` | Implement tasks from an OpenSpec change. |
| `openspec-update-change` | `/opsx-update` | Revise an OpenSpec change's existing planning artifacts and keep them coherent. |
| `openspec-ff-change` | `/opsx-ff` | Fast-forward through OpenSpec artifact creation. |
| `openspec-propose` | `/opsx-propose` | Propose a new change with all artifacts generated in one step. |
| `openspec-sync-specs` | `/opsx-sync` | Sync delta specs from a change to main specs. |
| `openspec-archive-change` | `/opsx-archive` | Archive a completed change. |
| `openspec-bulk-archive-change` | `/opsx-bulk-archive` | Archive multiple completed changes at once. |

@dragon-talon/dsh-openspec README · Installation：The package targets DeepSeek Harness, which supplies its peer dependencies (`@deepseek-ai/cordis`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-invariants`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill`).

Install the plugin into a DSH profile from npm:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <name> add @dragon-talon/dsh-openspec
```

Or add it to a plain Node project:

```bash
npm install @dragon-talon/dsh-openspec
```

@dragon-talon/dsh-openspec README · Installation：> `dsh plugin add` forwards to `pnpm add`, so any pnpm install spec works — a version range (`@dragon-talon/dsh-openspec@0.3.0`), `github:owner/repo`, `git+https://…`, a tarball, or a local path.
>
> Installing from a git URL instead of npm builds on install via the package's `prepare` script. `pnpm` blocks a git dependency's build script by default — if it refuses to run the build, add the package to `allowBuilds` in the profile's `pnpm-workspace.yaml` and re-run:
>
> ```yaml
> allowBuilds:
>   - "@dragon-talon/dsh-openspec"
> ```

@dragon-talon/dsh-openspec README · Configuration：```ts
import * as dshOpenspec from '@dragon-talon/dsh-openspec'

ctx.plugin(dshOpenspec, { aliases: false }) // disable the /opsx-* aliases
```

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `aliases` | `boolean` | `true` | Register the `/opsx-*` command aliases as user-only skills (`modelInvocable: false`). When `false`, only the 12 canonical `openspec-*` names are registered. |

@dragon-talon/dsh-openspec README · Development：```bash
npm install

npm run build   # tsc + tsdown → lib/
npm test        # vitest

@dragon-talon/dsh-openspec README · Syncing skills：`src/skills.ts` is auto-generated from a local OpenSpec checkout. Regenerate it when the upstream skills change:

```bash
npm run sync:skills         # regenerate src/skills.ts
npm run sync:skills:check   # CI check: exit non-zero when stale
```

The script reads `skills/*/SKILL.md` from an OpenSpec checkout — `~/Documents/github/OpenSpec` by default, overridable via `--openspec <path>` or the `OPENSPEC_REPO` environment variable.

[](https://github.com/dragonTalon/dsh-openspec)
[](LICENSE)
[](https://github.com/Fission-AI/OpenSpec)

这是一个面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 [Cordis](https://github.com/cordiverse/cordis) 插件,负责注册 12 个规范的 [OpenSpec](https://github.com/Fission-AI/OpenSpec) 工作流技能(使用其 kebab-case 名称)——从而 `/openspec-new-change` 可以通过 DSH 的用户指令注入和 `skill` 工具原生工作——同时提供 Claude 风格的 `/opsx-<id>` 命令别名(仅用户可调用,解析到对应规范技能的正文)。

@dragon-talon/dsh-openspec README · 对应的 OpenSpec 版本：本包将 OpenSpec 工作流技能固定在 **OpenSpec 1.14.1**([`@fission-ai/openspec`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@fission-ai/openspec),源码:[`Fission-AI/OpenSpec`](https://github.com/Fission-AI/OpenSpec))。

技能正文由 [`scripts/sync-openspec-skills.mjs`](scripts/sync-openspec-skills.mjs) 从 OpenSpec 仓库的 `skills/*/SKILL.md` 文件生成。详见[同步技能](#同步技能)。

@dragon-talon/dsh-openspec README · 技能列表：| 规范技能 | `/opsx-*` 别名 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `openspec-explore` | `/opsx-explore` | 进入探索模式——用于探索想法、调查问题、澄清需求。 |
| `openspec-new-change` | `/opsx-new` | 使用实验性的工件工作流新建一个 OpenSpec 变更。 |
| `openspec-continue-change` | `/opsx-continue` | 继续处理一个 OpenSpec 变更,创建下一个工件。 |
| `openspec-apply-change` | `/opsx-apply` | 实现一个 OpenSpec 变更中的任务。 |
| `openspec-update-change` | `/opsx-update` | 修订变更已有的规划工件并保持彼此一致。 |
| `openspec-ff-change` | `/opsx-ff` | 快速完成 OpenSpec 工件的创建。 |
| `openspec-propose` | `/opsx-propose` | 一步生成完整提案(设计、规格、任务)。 |
| `openspec-sync-specs` | `/opsx-sync` | 将变更中的增量规格同步到主规格。 |
| `openspec-archive-change` | `/opsx-archive` | 归档一个已完成的变更。 |
| `openspec-bulk-archive-change` | `/opsx-bulk-archive` | 一次性归档多个已完成的变更。 |
| `openspec-verify-change` | `/opsx-verify` | 校验实现是否与变更工件一致。 |
| `openspec-onboard` | `/opsx-onboard` | OpenSpec 引导式上手教程。 |

@dragon-talon/dsh-openspec README · 同步技能：`src/skills.ts` 由本地 OpenSpec checkout 自动生成。上游技能变化时重新生成:

```bash
npm run sync:skills         # 重新生成 src/skills.ts
npm run sync:skills:check   # CI 校验:内容过期时以非零码退出
```

脚本从 OpenSpec checkout 读取 `skills/*/SKILL.md`——默认路径 `~/Documents/github/OpenSpec`,可通过 `--openspec <path>` 或环境变量 `OPENSPEC_REPO` 覆盖。
